Wednesday’s NBA slate closes with a late-night double feature. Boston visits Denver at 9 p.m. ET, and the Warriors take on the Mavericks in Dallas at 9:30 p.m. ET. We’ve rounded up the best sportsbook and pick’em promos for new users, worth more than $2,000 in combined bonuses, plus a play at each one.

Celtics vs Nuggets | Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026 at 9:00 p.m. ET | Ball Arena, Denver, CO

Boston arrives as one of the East’s best teams and one of the league’s toughest road outs. Denver runs its offense through Nikola Jokic and is tough to beat at altitude.

Warriors vs Mavericks | Wednesday, Nov. 18, 2026 at 9:30 p.m. ET | American Airlines Center, Dallas, TX

Golden State brings one of the league’s best 3-point offenses into Dallas, where Cooper Flagg and the Mavericks look to defend home court. Our theme across these books: the home teams carry value in the late window.

BetMGM Sportsbook: Mavericks Moneyline

BetMGM bonus code FOXNEWS covers your first bet up to $1,500. If Dallas is a home underdog, it’s the right swing for a protected bet. If the Mavericks win, you cash at plus odds. If not, BetMGM refunds your stake in bonus bets.

Hard Rock Bet gives new users $500 in No Sweat Bets with a $5 wager. Two efficient offenses and Denver’s altitude can turn this into a high-scoring game late.

FanDuel gives new users $200 in bonus bets for betting $5 a day for four days. Boston will double Jokic, and he’ll make the Celtics pay with his passing.
